 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRATEEK JALAN  ORDER % 28.03.2026
This petition was scheduled to be listed on 02.03.2026, but has been listed today, as 02.03.2026 was declared a holiday vide Notification No. 64/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 27.02.2026.
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

Mr. Hitesh Vali, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State, and learned counsel, accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 2.
3.
